evidence.text: Maren Solberg traveled to Oslo for two weeks in July 2023 to study Edvard Munch's techniques at the Munch Museum.
Maren Solberg and Jun Takeda have adjacent studios at the Gowanus Arts Building and share a wall-mounted tool rack between their spaces.

Zara Osei speaks English, Twi, and French fluently.

evidence.text: Jun Takeda grew up in Portland, Oregon, and moved to New York in 2019 after graduating from the Pacific Northwest College of Art.
Jun Takeda and Ines Varga exhibited together in a two-person show called 'Fire and Form' at the Greenpoint Gallery in February 2024.
Ines Varga uses oil-based glazes that she purchases from Maren Solberg, who buys them in bulk.
Maren Solberg and Zara Osei co-curated an exhibition called 'Thresholds' at the BRIC Arts Media gallery in Fort Greene in April 2024.
Ines Varga's mother, Katalin Varga, teaches Hungarian language and literature at Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland.
